newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA, ZEMES BANKA CANCEL MERGER.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA, ZEMES BANKA CANCEL MERGER.

text.p: Leading bank Unibanka and fellow bank Zemes Banka on Tuesday said they have called off merger talks and will continue to operate as two independent banks.

"After discussions with major shareholders of the two banks and with their full support, it is considered that better shareholder value would be achieved in the medium term if A/S Latvijas Unibanka and A/S Latvijas Zemes Banka were to continue to operate as independent banks," Zemes Banka said in a statement.
"Therefore the merger investigations and discussions will now cease," the bank added.
The two banks said in a statement released almost at the same time that the results of the synergy to be achieved after the merger were not as big as first seemed possible.
"Both banks will continue to operate together in a normal manner in the future as leading participants in the Latvian financial market," the statement added.
The banks called off the merger just as Unibanka shareholders were due to vote on it at a shareholder meeting today.
"Both banks are recognised as financially stable and well-managed institutions with important roles in the Latvian economy," the banks added.
